INVALID_PAYMENT_REFERENCE: Valid UPI UTR / transaction reference bharein.
INVALID_REQUIRED_DATE: Required date sahi future/current date honi chahiye.
INVALID_TIER: Selected hamper tier valid nahi hai.
TOO_MANY_PRODUCTS: Selected hamper ke liye bahut zyada products hain.
PRODUCT_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_TIER: Ek ya zyada products is hamper budget me available nahi hain.
PRODUCT_MIX_EXCEEDS_TIER: Selected product mix is hamper budget se bahar hai.
POLICY_VERSION_MISMATCH: Policy update hui hai. Terms dobara accept karein.
PAYMENT_REFERENCE_ALREADY_USED: Ye payment reference pehle use ho chuka hai.
RATE_LIMITED: Bahut zyada attempts hue hain. Thodi der baad try karein.
AUTH_REQUIRED: Order place karne ke liye mobile number + password se login karein.
ACCOUNT_EXISTS: Is mobile number ka account already hai. Login karein.
ACCOUNT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Account service abhi available nahi hai. WhatsApp support se contact karein.
ORDER_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Order service abhi available nahi hai. Support se contact karein.
UNKNOWN: Order submit nahi ho paya. Please try again.
INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: Order request invalid hai. Please retry.
PACKING_VIDEO_NOT_READY: Packing video abhi approval ke liye ready nahi hai.
INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: Ye order status change allowed nahi hai.
ISSUE_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_STATUS: Is order stage par issue report available nahi hai.
ISSUE_WINDOW_EXPIRED: Delivery ke baad issue reporting window khatam ho chuki hai.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Mobile number ya password match nahi hua.
APPROVAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Approval abhi process nahi ho paya.
ISSUE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Issue abhi submit nahi ho paya.
UPLOAD_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Video upload service abhi unavailable hai.
PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED: Payment setup abhi complete nahi hai. Order placement temporarily unavailable hai.
PACKING_VIDEO_UPLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED: Is order stage par packing video upload available nahi hai.
SHIPPING_UPDATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Shipping details is order stage par update nahi ki ja sakti.
PACKING_VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: Packing video allowed size limit se badi hai.
PACKING_VIDEO_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Packing video format allowed nahi hai.
